name: DWP Stat-Xplore
description: Universal Credit and benefit claimant data.
used_for: Understanding financial hardship, worklessness and benefit claimant patterns.

name: Police.UK Open Data
description: Street-level crime and anti-social behaviour incidents.
used_for: Measuring community safety, crime burden and local crime-related deprivation signals.

name: OpenStreetMap
description: Location data for amenities, shops, services, land use and highways.
used_for: Measuring access to services, local infrastructure and neighbourhood environment.

name: HM Land Registry
description: House price and property transaction data.
used_for: Capturing housing market conditions, affordability and transaction activity.

name: Gov.UK Connectivity
description: Accessibility and journey-time data for key local services.
used_for: Measuring access to services such as GP practices, green spaces and transport links.

name: West of England Population Look-Up
description: Population by age band and small-area geography.
used_for: Creating population denominators and age-share indicators for Bristol LSOAs.

name: ArcGIS LSOA Look-Up
description: Boundary and lookup data for LSOAs, MSOAs, wards and local authorities.
used_for: Joining model outputs to small-area geographies and supporting map views.

name: English Indices of Deprivation
description: Official deprivation scores, ranks and deciles published by government.
used_for: Training, benchmarking and comparing model outputs against official deprivation measures.

name: Indices of Deprivation - Bristol
description: Bristol-specific extract of official deprivation scores and ranks.
used_for: Validating Bristol-focused outputs and supporting local comparison views.
